contract: POST /emails/ereader-devices candidate recorded from server/routers/ApiRouter.js:280. This evidence covers successful admin update normalization, persisted readback, update/no-op realtime event behavior, and selected absent/null/empty users shapes. Authentication denials, malformed payloads, delivery routes, and other edge cases remain unverified.

invariants.contract: Invalid availability options and specificUsers with an empty users list normalize availabilityOption to adminOrUp; non-specific options clear users only when users has a truthy length, preserving omitted, null, and empty fields otherwise.
An identical normalized device update returns the same response without changing the persisted updatedAt value or emitting another ereader-devices-updated event.
A changed normalized device payload persists the new device state and emits one admin-scoped ereader-devices-updated event.

evidence: go-backend/contracts/parity/email-devices-differential-report.json: fresh pinned v2.37.2 differential, nine route/readback/event/state cases matched; seven normalized devices persisted identically, including string/object users.length cases; changed updates persisted and emitted one admin event; identical repeat emitted none and left updatedAt unchanged.
Go unit regression verifies normalization and repeat no-op timestamp/event behavior.
exceptions: Evidence is limited to the named successful admin update and selected normalization/repeat cases; request denial, malformed payload, SMTP test/delivery, and broader authorization behavior are not covered.

The enclosing differential run used EXP_PROXY_SUPPORT=1 for its local cover fixture and skipped the private-address SSRF case; that skip is unrelated to this email route and is recorded separately in the report.
